subject: age-specific survival in robust-design CR model with censored and truncated data

messages.author: ca3e0d1feca30c8c
messages.subject: age-specific survival in robust-design CR model with censored and truncated data
parts:
I am working on a 10 year dataset of capture-recapture data for bears
collected in a robust-design. We are trying to estimate age-specific
survival for four age classes (cub (0 years), juvenile (1 year),
sub-adult (2 years) and adult (>=3 years)). The data are left-truncated
(some individuals were born before the beginning of the study) and
right-censored (some individuals are still alive at the end of the
study). We have birth information for quite a few individuals
(observations at dens) but almost no confirmed death. Only a small
proportion of individuals has a complete capture history (birth to
death). Age of individuals is known when sighted.

I have a working multi-state CR model but don't know how to deal with
the truncation (currently survivals are all overestimated based on
simulated data). I tried adding additional occasions before the first
year of data but that does not work.  I am aware of the work by Colchero
and Clark 2012 and Matechou et al. 2013 MEE but I am hoping to implement
a model in JAGS.

Any thoughts and suggestions are welcome. Thanks,

Mathias
